title: regional-tailspin-hedge-hotpatch
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: During a multi-region degradation last week we observed a rapid 'tailspin' where aggressive SLO-driven tenant eviction in Region-A amplified cross-region failover traffic into Region-B, triggering a cascade and KV-cache churn that impacted warm standby readiness. This change introduces a conservative emergency hedging path ("tailspin-hedge") that temporarily alters QoS decisions and warms failover targets with a lightweight probe before bulk re-routing. Goals: 1) prevent cascade amplification by soft-shelving noisy tenants instead of eviction; 2) preserve KV cache prefixes for in-flight failovers; 3) add a short warmup probe and throttled warm-reject window for candidate regions; 4) provide a single toggle for rapid rollback and a phased canary sequence. Summary of changes: 1) runtime/shedder: add TailspinHedge controller - holds tenant eviction for X seconds, marks tenants as 'soft-shelved' and routes reduced-weight hedged requests; 2) routing: introduce regional-warmup-prober that issues 5 lightweight KV-preserve probes to standby region before re-route; 3) kvsync: guard to snapshot hot prefixes to mirrored cache on candidate region (best-effort); 4) telemetry: add hedging metrics (hedge.entered/hedge.exited/hedge.probe_latency) and an 'amplification_detected' signal; 5) config: hotpatch feature flag redwood.experimental.tailspin_hedge with status, initial timeouts, and max-shelve-percentage; 6) migration script: add opt-in rollout that flips feature flag on Canary pool; 7) docs: operational runbook snippet and rollback steps. Testing: unit tests for controller decision logic, integration test that simulates region-A overload and asserts no >10% amplification to region-B, e2e canary in perf-canary infra with synthetic tenant spikes. Checklist: [x] unit tests added and passing [x] integration test updated [x] telemetry dashboards stubbed [x] canary plan included [x] runbook + rollback documented Links: Linear ENG-4281 (root cause), SUP-912 (support incident), runbook: https://linear.app/redwood/board/ENG-4281 || Commits: listed separately below. Merge notes: squash-merged to main; feature gated behind config and enabled only for Canary pool for 24h before wider rollout. Rollback: flip redwood.experimental.tailspin_hedge=false and trigger kvsync revert hook to stop mirroring.
